profile.headline: CMA, ACCA — Strategic Finance & FP&A Professional
profile.currentCompany: SIXT, Samara Land Transportation Services Co. Ltd.
profile.resumeSummary: CMA and ACCA-qualified Strategic Finance, FP&A and Business Performance professional with 15+ years across Saudi Arabia and the MENA region. Specializes in multi-year planning, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, capital appraisal, and digital finance transformation across large-scale retail, F&B franchising, transportation and mobility, fuel and energy, consulting, and Big Four audit environments. Recognized for shortening reporting cycles, strengthening forecast discipline, and turning complex financial and operational data into clear executive decision support.
profile.workHistory:
SIXT, Samara Land Transportation Services Co. Ltd. | Khobar, Saudi Arabia
Financial Planning, Analysis & Reporting Manager | Oct 2024 – Sep 2025
- Led FP&A, reporting, modeling and decision support for planning, investments and business performance.
- Built forecasts, KPI dashboards and scenarios; delivered ROI/ROCE appraisals and cost/working-capital reviews.

Independent Financial Advisory & FP&A Consulting | Islamabad, Pakistan
FP&A Consultant / Financial Planning, Analysis & Reporting Advisor | Dec 2021 – Jun 2024
- Multi-year strategic plans, valuations, feasibility studies, budgets/forecasts and Power BI dashboards for multi-industry clients.
- Improved profitability and reporting through process automation, scenario planning and cost initiatives.

Panda Group, Head Office | Saudi Arabia
Manager, Planning, Reporting & Operational Finance | Nov 2017 – Nov 2021
- Cut Group reporting time by 4 weeks via VBA models, automated workflows and visualization.
- Owned multi-year plans, budgets, rolling forecasts and capital appraisals (NPV/IRR/ROI); mentored finance teams.

Alamar Foods Company (Master Franchiser of Domino's Pizza) | Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
Group Reporting Manager | Nov 2015 – Nov 2017
- Led group reporting, budgeting and forecasting across KSA and MENAP.
- Reduced the monthly reporting lag from 10 weeks to under 6 weeks through automation and standardization.

United Fuel Company (in partnership with PETRONAS) | Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
Head of Accounting & Finance / Fractional CFO | Jun 2014 – Oct 2015
- Built the finance function from the ground up: policies, controls, reporting, budgeting, cash flow and compliance.
- Implemented Sage ERP; partnered with PETRONAS directors and the Group CFO on planning and operational decisions.

Azizia Panda United, Head Office | Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
Assistant Manager, Planning & Reporting | Feb 2010 – Jun 2014
- Budget reviews, variance analysis, executive summaries and management reporting for leadership.
- Improved reporting accuracy and efficiency through VBA, financial modeling and reporting automation.

PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC) | Islamabad, Pakistan
Supervising Senior, Audit & Assurance | Mar 2006 – Dec 2009
- Led audits across financial statements, accounting records, controls and compliance.
- Supervised audit teams, reviewed workpapers, identified issues and coordinated client communication.
profile.coverLetter: I am writing to express my interest in a strategic finance / FP&A leadership role where rigorous planning, clear management reporting and commercial partnership drive better decisions. As a CMA and ACCA-qualified professional with 15+ years across Saudi Arabia and the MENA region — in retail, F&B franchising, mobility, fuel and energy, consulting and Big Four audit — I bring proven strength in budgeting, forecasting, capital appraisal and reporting automation. I have cut group reporting cycles by four weeks, reduced a monthly reporting lag from ten weeks to under six, and built a finance function from the ground up in partnership with PETRONAS directors and a Group CFO. I am based in Saudi Arabia and available to start immediately. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience aligns with your team's priorities.
